mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25%) signal accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained liquidity support.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods with FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in federal funds rate exceeding 0.1 percentage points (FEDFUNDS rise > 0.1pp) signals imminent monetary tightening, triggering immediate equity selling pressure that produces negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate deteriorating housing market conditions, which precede broader economic weakness and predict negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict negative returns in >55% of cases over 3-year rolling windows, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 8.0% (UNRATE > 8.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy to stimulate job growth, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of UNRATE > 8.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly payroll growth exceeding 100,000 jobs (PAYEMS > 100k) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of PAYEMS > 100k months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Two consecutive months of industrial production below 95.0 (INDPRO < 95.0) signal manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output capacity and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and rising core inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicate stagflationary pressures, which reduce corporate profit margins and predict negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of declining GDPC1 and rising CPIAUCSL fails to predict negative returns in >55% of cases over 3-year rolling windows, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During zero-lower-bound periods (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25%), the Federal Reserve's commitment to maintaining ultra-low rates supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as investors price in prolonged accommodative policy.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25% periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
